title: Playbook
description: Agentic-rollback playbook entry per ARCHITECT-REPLY-49 Addition #27 D2. Loaded by engine/agent/playbook.ts; validated at load time. Each entry defines a recovery action the FM agent may propose when `applies_when` conditions match + `reversibility_required` is compatible with the deploy's reversibility tag (rail e per D6).

id.description: Stable identifier. snake_case; matches filename stem.

version.description: Semver per Q2. v1 entries default to 1.0.0.

firing_families.description: Subset of families that must be co-firing for this entry to match. Empty array → entry applies regardless of firing family set.

min_family_count.description: Minimum number of distinct firing families for this entry to apply. 0 → entry applies even on all-silent groups (unusual).

verdict_class.description: Applies only when the group's verdict falls in this class. `both` matches either rollback or extend.

reversibility_required.description: Rail (e) anchor per REPLY-44 / D6. Entry is filtered from the FM input when the deploy's reversibility tag is incompatible. `any` matches all three reversibility values including `conditional` (treated as forward_only conservatively per P4).

confidence_threshold.description: Per-entry confidence floor per D6 rail (c). Agent's top-level ConfiguredAgent.confidence_threshold is the global default; entries may tighten (not loosen) it.

orchestrator_command_template.description: Templated action string the orchestrator (or human operator via UI) executes after proposal confirmation. Template placeholders use `${var}` syntax; rendered by the FM at proposal time.

expected_effect.description: What the operator should observe if the action succeeds. Helps verify effectiveness + catches no-op cases.

category.description: D2 action categorization. Drives oncall-UI grouping and ProposedAction.playbook_category.
